correctness.rationale: For B=lambda_- I+(lambda_+-lambda_-)P, functional calculus gives Gamma_k=sigma^2(q_- I+(q_+-q_-)P). Each Rademacher probe has w_j^2=1, hence signed relative error equals (p_hat-p)(t_k-1)/(1+p(t_k-1)). The ratio t_k falls strictly from kappa at k=1 to 1/kappa as k tends to infinity for 0<omega<=1/lambda_+; scalar absolute ratio is maximized at endpoints, with threshold p=1/2. P^2=P gives row off-diagonal square sum p(1-p), yielding horizon-free Hoeffding and an exact binomial flat-spike tail. Independent dense rational/float probes checked 720 scalar identities and 9 binomial normalizations; not the proof of all k.
